bench/seat_aliveness_2026-10-06.py.reason: NOT A BRIEF AT ALL, which is why validation does not apply. Its only prompt is the 7-word module constant PROBE_PROMPT, 'Reply with exactly one word: Ready!', dispatched with max_tokens=16 and max_retries=1. panel_brief_validate checks a REVIEW brief -- headings, figure provenance, the standards clause -- and a fixed 7-word liveness ping has none of those to check, so routing it through the validator would refuse every probe rather than catch anything. ON SPEND, which is the property the registry exists to protect: the probe adds no seat and reaches no route the run was not already authorised to dispatch with a full brief moments later, and it cannot authorise anything itself. Added 2026-10-08 after the guard flagged it; the file dates from 2026-10-06, when the aliveness probe was wired into the panel dispatcher on the founder's ruling, and the registry entry was the step that was missed. Task 5.2 was left marked DONE naming a test this file was failing, which the suite itself reports as a completion claim with no support.
